rules: REQUIRES dateFrom and dateTo as query params. Without them you get 422.
Example: params={"dateFrom": "2026-01-01", "dateTo": "2026-12-31"}
Use a broad date range. For year-end: dateFrom=YYYY-01-01, dateTo=YYYY-12-31.
Optional filters: number, description.
These are QUERY PARAMS via the params field — NOT json_body.
Method is PUT, not POST.
date is a QUERY PARAMETER: PUT /ledger/voucher/{id}/:reverse?date=YYYY-MM-DD
Do NOT send date in the request body.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.

payload.headline: 3/4 ledger corrections succeeded; VAT correction (Check 3) failed due to wrong amount/account logic
what_went_wrong: Check 3 (missing VAT line for 8850 NOK on account 2710) failed. Agent posted 2212.5 NOK to account 2710 (25% of 8850) instead of the correct VAT amount, and used account 2990 as contra instead of the proper expense/creditor account.
Agent could not fully identify original voucher contra accounts because the API returned truncated historical postings, leading to guessed contra accounts (2990) for corrections 2, 3, and 4.
The VAT calculation logic was incorrect: 25% of 8850 = 2212.5 NOK was posted, but the scoring expected a different amount or account structure for the VAT correction entry.
what_worked: 3 out of 4 corrective vouchers were accepted and scored correctly (misposting 6540→6860, duplicate reversal, amount correction on 7100).
Zero 4xx errors across all 15 API calls — clean execution with no failed requests.
what_to_try_next: For the missing VAT correction, post directly to account 2710 with the VAT amount (2212.5 NOK) and use account 6540 as the contra (debit 6540 for the VAT amount), not a transitional account like 2990.
Before creating corrective vouchers, fetch the full original voucher details using GET /ledger/voucher/{id} to identify exact contra accounts rather than guessing with transitional accounts.
Verify the VAT rate assumption: if the expected VAT is 25% of 8850 = 2212.5 NOK, confirm the account structure matches what Tripletex expects (debit 6540 2212.5, credit 2710 2212.5).
unnecessary_calls: Multiple GET /ledger/account calls (8 total) could be reduced by batching account lookups or caching results from the first call.
GET /ledger/postingByDate and GET /ledger/posting were both called but returned insufficient data — one consolidated posting search would suffice.
GET /ledger/account for resource_id=None results indicate failed lookups that could be avoided with better account number filtering parameters.
